name: How do cash offers compare to offers with financing in terms of closing timeline?

mainEntity.name: How do cash offers compare to offers with financing in terms of closing timeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cash offers generally lead to a much faster closing, often completing within weeks. Offers with financing require the buyer to secure a loan, which involves appraisals, underwriting, and lender approvals, typically extending the timeline to 30-60 days or more. This difference is a key practical tradeoff when choosing between offers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cash offers close faster, usually in weeks, as they avoid lengthy lender approvals required for financed offers.
